protocolRefs.multiCallChain: HTTP client protocol: HTTP AUTHENTICATE / HTTP SET OPTION / HTTP SET CERTIFICATES FOLDER configure per-process client state -> HTTP Get or HTTP Request issues the request and consumes that state -> HTTP GET OPTION / HTTP Get certificates folder read back the currently active state.

overloadPatches.semanticRole: Sets the active client certificates folder (used to locate the client certificate files required by Web servers) for all processes of the current session.

constraints: certificatesFolder may be relative to the application structure file or absolute, expressed using system (platform-native) path syntax; if the folder doesn't exist or the pathname is invalid, an error is generated (interceptable via ON ERR CALL).
Takes effect immediately for subsequent HTTP Request/HTTP Get calls in every process of the database, without restarting the application.
